title: Late Night Secret Meeting
next_chapter_hook: "Just as the Five Elders were deep in their scheming, Mo Xiansheng in the corner suddenly closed his eyes. A wisp of remnant soul trembled faintly within the Turtle Shell, as if sensing some ominous presence peering at them."

text.content:
"The night was as dark as ink. Inside the Elders' Hall of the Tianqing Sect, lanterns blazed brightly.

Five silhouettes sat on either side of a rosewood long table, each with a gloomy expression. Outside, a fine rain fell continuously, raindrops striking the bronze bells on the eaves, producing a monotonous yet chilling sound. The Tianji Diagram hung in the center of the hall, flickering in the candlelight as if even the way of heaven was watching this unspeakable secret meeting."

dialogue.content: "That waste has grown even more insolent lately."

text.content:
"The speaker was the Third Elder, seated on the left of the head seat. His name was Zhao Qianqiu, his face gaunt as a skull, his triangular eyes glittering with keen light. He toyed with the jade ruyi in his hand, the corner of his lips curving into a sinister smile.

'He's merely a floor-sweeping Servant Disciple, yet he dared to surpass our carefully cultivated seed disciple at the Sect Competition. If I hadn't seen it with my own eyes, this old man truly wouldn't have believed it.'"

dialogue.content: "Second Elder Sun Tieya let out a coldscoffed coldly, his voice like rolling thunder: 'I said long ago, this boy cannot be left alive. Wasn't Chen Xuan the same way, rising step by step?'"

text.content:
"At the mention of 'Chen Xuan,' the atmosphere in the hall suddenly froze.

In the corner, Mo Xiansheng, who had been silent all along, slightly raised his eyes. The gaze from deep within his remnant soul swept across those present. He remembered that night—the torrential rain ten years ago, when Chen Xuan died precisely within the conspiracy these people had encircled and killed. And the 'Turtle Shell' they spoke of was the Tianji Record Fragment he had guarded for a full sixty years."

dialogue.content: "Since we could kill Chen Xuan back then, we can kill him today too."

text.content: "Fourth Elder Zhou Tianji stroked his beard and laughed, his laughter like the cry of a night owl: 'The Elder's words are most apt. Chen Xuan back then was so brilliantly talented, the Tianji Record at its full ten levels of power in his hands—didn't we still suppress him together? A mere waste of a thing, could he possibly turn the world upside down?'"

dialogue.content: "It's just... where exactly is the Turtle Shell?"

text.content:
"This was the voice of the Grand Elder Ling Yuan, his authority tinged with an undeniable greed.

Ten years ago he had already coveted the Tianji Record. That encirclement and killing were meant to grant him this supreme treasure, yet Chen Xuan, before dying, had fled the Turtle Shell into the Void, its whereabouts unknown ever since. It was only three months ago that he sensed a familiar aura on Chen Ji—the unique fate fluctuation belonging exclusively to the Tianji Record."

"Fifth Elder Li Xuanming suddenly spoke, his voice sinisterly cold: 'This old man has noticed that every time that waste动用 certain abilities, his face turns deathly pale as paper. According to ancient records, the use of the Tianji Record requires the consumption of Heavenly Fate Value... Perhaps that is his fatal weakness.'"

"Heavenly Fate Value.

These three words were like a key, unlocking the darkest corners of everyone's hearts. Their understanding of the Tianji Record ran far deeper than any outsider could imagine—after all, it was under their relentless pressure that Chen Xuan back then had no choice but to frantically use the Tianji Record's abilities, ultimately dying when his Heavenly Fate Value was exhausted.

His death was so wretched that not even his soul could be preserved."

dialogue.content: "In that case, why not... make some arrangements at the Sect Competition?"

text.content: "Ling Yuan's eyes flashed brilliantly: 'What do you mean?'"

dialogue.content: "Zhou Tianji grinned wickedly: 'During combat, blades and swords are blind. If that waste were to be 'accidentally' killed by Han Lie's misstep, who could say anything? The Han family would also be enraged over the death of their direct-line genius, and then all the fury would point at that waste, not at us.'"

text.content:
"A brilliant scheme.

The Fourth Elder's strategy was simple yet vicious. Han Lie was the number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect, hot-tempered and volatile, easiest to be manipulated. With just a little guidance to let him and Chen Ji 'fairly duel' during the competition, Han Lie's strength would ensure Chen Ji's death.

At that time, they would only need to sit back and reap the渔翁之利."

"However, what they did not know was that at this moment, in the dilapidated small room of the Servants' Quarters, Chen Ji sat cross-legged, the Turtle Shell before him glowing with a faint azure light.

Three hours earlier, he had already seen everything that transpired tonight in the Elders' Hall."

"A faint smile curved his lips. Chen Ji tucked the Turtle Shell into his chest, a sharp gleam flickering in his eyes.

Han Lie... Sect Competition... accidental death?

Interesting. They seemed to have forgotten that when they used the same tactics against Chen Xuan back then, the Tianji Record's prophecy was—Chen Xuan would not die."

choice.prompt: "After Chen Ji saw through the Five Elders' conspiracy, he must decide how to respond:"

choices.text: "Turn their scheme against them, draw out the snake from its hole"
choices.description: "Deliberately reveal flaws to let Han Lie succeed, while actually laying a天罗地网, causing the Five Elders to walk right into the trap themselves."
choices.risk_hint: "If it fails, one will be completely exposed"

text.content:
"Chen Ji rose slowly and pushed open the window, letting the night wind pour in. This was precisely the effect he wanted—let them think everything was under their control.

The chess game is already set; only waiting for the pieces to fall into position."

choices.description: "Su Qingyao is the only person who has sensed something wrong about him. Perhaps her strength can be used to break the deadlock."

text.content: "Su Qingyao... that woman is more perceptive than the Five Elders imagined. If she can be drawn into the chess game, the situation would be entirely different."

choices.text: "Go all out, expose everything and counterattack"
choices.description: "Before they make their move, take preemptive action and expose the truth of Chen Xuan's death to the public."
choices.visible_reward: "Shake the authority of the Five Elders"

text.content: "Since they want his life, don't blame him for being merciless. Chen Xuan's blood debt is time for someone to repay."

"Meanwhile, the secret meeting inside the Elders' Hall continued.

Ling Yuan lifted his tea cup, his murky eyes flickering brilliantly: 'Ten years ago, we owed that Turtle Shell too much. This time, we absolutely cannot fail again. Chen Xuan's curse before he died back then... this old man still has lingering fears.'"

"In the corner, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled faintly.

He heard the name Chen Xuan. That name was like a thorn, deeply embedded in his already numb soul. As the guardian of the chessboard left behind by Chen Xuan, he witnessed his disciple's fall yet could only remain helpless within the depths of the Turtle Shell.

Now, the cycle of history seemed poised to repeat itself."

"The rain outside grew heavier, as if even the heavens were mourning this conspiracy.

Just as the Five Elders were about to finalize their plan, Ling Yuan suddenly frowned, his gaze sweeping toward the corner: 'Mo Xiansheng, what is your view?'"

"Mo Xiansheng's voice wascalm得近乎cold, as if merely going through the motions. Yet deep within his remnant soul, a faint glimmer was quietly kindling—the final mark left by Chen Xuan on the first page of the Tianji Record.

If these old fiends knew they had been watched by the Tianji Record all along... who knows how they'd feel?"

choice.prompt: "Mo Xiansheng, as a remnant soul guardian, must decide whether to intervene in this conspiracy:"

choices.text: "Secretly pass a warning to Chen Ji"
choices.description: "Use the connection between his remnant soul and the Turtle Shell to warn Chen Ji in a dream, giving him time to prepare."

text.content: "Mo Xiansheng closed his eyes. A faint fluctuation surged from his remnant soul, penetrating layers of the Void, arriving at the dilapidated small room in the Servants' Quarters."

choices.text: "Continue to stay silent, watch and wait"
choices.description: "Trust that the inheritor chosen by Chen Xuan has his own way of responding; do not rashly intervene."

text.content: "Chen Xuan entrusted everything to Chen Ji back then; there must be profound meaning in that. Mo Xiansheng decided to trust the inheritor's abilities."

"Ling Yuan gave Mo Xiansheng a deep look, always feeling that this old fellow had been rather strange lately, but unable to pinpoint exactly what was off.

'Forget it.' He rose to his feet, brushing his sleeves. 'The Sect Competition is still seven days away. In these seven days, all of you had better keep a close watch on that waste. Any sign of disturbance must be reported immediately.'"

"The Five Elders nodded in unison, their eyes filled with sinister malice.

What they did not know was that while they were conspiring, in that dilapidated room of the Servants' Quarters, Chen Ji had already opened his eyes.

He heard the warning transmitted by Mo Xiansheng."

"A meaningful smile curved his lips. Chen Ji murmured to himself:

'Seven days... that's enough.'

He raised his hand and gently stroked the Turtle Shell at his chest. The Tianji Record Fragment glowed with a faint azure light, as if responding to his will."
"Han Lie, your fate... I have already foreseen."

"On the rainy night seven days later, it will be the end of Han Lie's life.

But before that, Chen Ji intended to personally turn this chess game completely upside down. The Five Elders wanted his life? Fine, then let them come and try—let's see who first steps into the underworld.

Outside the hall, the rain began to ease. The night was deep as ink. And above the heavens, an invisible eye was watching everything within the Tianqing Sect."

"That was the Eye of Heavenly Dao.

It witnessed this secret meeting, and it watched Chen Ji in the Servants' Quarters. Every generation of prophets were its chess pieces; the Tianji Record was merely one of its pieces spread across the mortal world.

And now, a new variable was quietly taking shape."

choice.prompt: "After receiving Mo Xiansheng's warning, Chen Ji decides his next move:"

choices.text: "Proactively approach Ye Qing, borrow Demonic Path power"
choices.description: "Ye Qing's 'Demonic Path Mist' can conceal the aura of the Tianji Record. If cooperation can be achieved, the Five Elders will lose all means of tracking him."
choices.risk_hint: "The Demonic Path Saintess's intentions are unclear"

text.content: "Ye Qing... that woman who has been used by the Holy Sect until now. She, like Chen Ji, is a pitiful person caught in fate's grip. Perhaps she could become an ally."

choices.text: "Stay put, bide time and wait for the right moment"
choices.description: "Since everything has already been foreseen, why not respond to change with constancy, letting the enemy reveal their weaknesses first."
choices.visible_cost: "Consume 5 points of Heavenly Fate Value per day"

text.content: "Sometimes, stillness is more dangerous than movement. They think he is a lamb to be slaughtered, unaware that beneath the sheep's skin lies a bloodthirsty wolf."

choices.text: "Enter the tiger's den, investigate the Tianji Diagram"
choices.description: "The Tianji Diagram hanging in the Elders' Hall seems to hide secrets. If one could infiltrate and explore, perhaps a way to break the deadlock could be found."

text.content: "The Tianji Diagram... why are the patterns on that diagram so similar to the Tianji Record Fragment? Was Chen Xuan's death back then related to this diagram?"

"Just as Chen Ji was contemplating, a soft sound came from outside the window.

Someone was coming.

Chen Ji frowned but made no move. He had already seen this 'surprise'—the visitor was no enemy, but Su Qingyao, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of the Tianqing Sect.

This aloof and formidable woman was the only one who had sensed something wrong with Chen Ji. She had come infinitely close to the truth three times, and three times he had cleverly defused her suspicions."

"Tonight, she came again.

'Chen Ji, I know you're in there.' Su Qingyao's clear and cold voice sounded at the door. 'Open up, I have questions for you.'

Chen Ji rose slowly, a playful smile curling his lips. Fourth time, is it? Interesting.

He wanted to see what kind of truth this Inner Disciple Senior Fellow intended to uncover tonight."
